title: THE 10-DECADE LINE: the law's mass coverage 10^2.6-10^14.4 M_sun, synthesized from the committed per-channel registers

law.clusters: T_X = mu m_p sigma^2/(2 k_B), mu = 0.6
law.note: ONE amplitude line in log-log: slope 1 (Nu = 1) across all covered decades

structure.note: sigma_obs follows the baryon-virial locus sigma^2 = G M_*/(eta r_h), eta ~ 7; the law's floor (sigma_pred) is crossed at M_cross = 1.23e5 M_sun where r_M/r_h = 3.39 = eta/2 -- the r_M/r_h boundary
the dSph FLOOR: the law's dispersion face holds at median -0.049 dex; G03G 7-dwarf floor median 0.00 dex (G074 cross-ref)

structure.residual_convention: slope of log10(pred/obs) vs log10(M_*) over all 34, +0.159 means the shortfall is one-sided at the faint end
structure.note: THE UFD DEPARTURE: one-sided ABOVE the line (obs sigma ~2.5x pred); mass-dependent residual +0.159 +- 0.021 per dex of log10(pred/obs) (G070 V2 FAIL) -- the dispersion channel's low-end split
rms 0.150 vs the 0.20 bar (G114 V1 PASS); mass-independent (slope -0.00)

SPARC.label: SPARC (G071)
SPARC.obs_counterpart: V_obs at the outermost ring (per galaxy); 641 rings pooled

structure.note: registered pooled statement: rms 0.1454 dex over 641 rings, slope +0.010/dex (mass independence); per-galaxy outer-ring reading above (the ring-pooled median -0.085 includes the inner Newtonian-rise rings where v_obs < v_flat)

clusters.label: clusters (G075)
clusters.pred_form: sigma = (G M_b a0)^(1/4)/sqrt(2);  T_X = mu m_p sigma^2/(2 k_B), mu = 0.6
clusters.obs_counterpart: kTvir (Eckert+17) and sigma_dyn,3D = sqrt(G M500/R500) (Ettori+19 HSE); sigma_gal,los = sqrt(kT/mu m_p) validates T (G109, rms 0.062 dex)

structure.note: THE REGISTERED CLUSTER GAP: T_obs = 3.57x T_pred (scatter 0.05 dex, parallel not scattered); sigma_dyn,3D = 1.89x sigma_pred -- the triad's amplitude fails at the top end (G075 V2 FAIL, factor 1.5 bar), the normalization stays an input (G017 free dust); G109: galaxies and gas equipartite at 0.062 dex so the offset is the law's, not the tracer's

dsph_hi.note: the same baryon masses observed by two channels: dispersion-supported dSphs (M_*; gas negligible) and rotation-supported gas-dominated HI dwarfs (M_b = M_gas + M_*); both sit on (G M_b a0)^(1/4) with sigma = v/sqrt(2) -- the rotation/dispersion faces of ONE line at identical mass

gc_dsph.note: dispersion-dispersion overlap at the law's floor boundary: the GC crossing M_cross = 1.23e5 M_sun (r_M/r_h = eta/2) lies INSIDE this window; the dSphs at the same masses (Draco +0.22, Carina +0.05, Sextans +0.05) sit within ~0.2 dex of the same line the GCs straddle -- the two dispersion channels agree at the floor

hi_sparc.note: rotation-rotation overlap: the deep-end HI sample and the low-mass SPARC tail observe the same masses; both rotation channels, both on the line

gap.note: NO committed channel between SPARC's top (10^10.8) and the clusters' bottom (10^13.7): massive ellipticals and galaxy groups are the uncovered ~2.9 decades -- an honest coverage gap, not a claim

V1.statement: THE POOLED LINE ACROSS 10^2.6-10^14.4: OLS slope b = 0.988 +- 0.020 on N = 248 objects (the comprehensive Nu = 1 test: (b-1)/se = -0.57), rms about the identity line 0.221 dex; the CORE population (GC+bright dSph+HI+SPARC, the on-line channels) gives b = 0.987 +- 0.024, rms 0.191 dex. The pooled rms is set by the two REGISTERED end departures (UFD +0.40, clusters +0.27/+0.55 dex), not by slope curvature.

V2.statement: OVERLAP-CHANNEL CONSISTENCY at 10^6.25-10^7.51 M_sun: the dispersion channel (dSphs: median |r| 0.114, median r -0.114) and the rotation channel (HI dwarfs: median |r| 0.056, median r +0.012) observe the SAME masses and land on the SAME line within ~0.07 dex combined -- v_flat = (G M_b a0)^(1/4) and sigma = v/sqrt(2) are one line at fixed mass, not two calibrations.

V3.statement: HONEST: the law is ONE line across ~12 decades -- the comprehensive Nu = 1 test at the pooled level gives b = 0.988 +- 0.020 on N = 248 objects ((b-1)/se = -0.57) and the macro-channel fit b = 0.976 +- 0.081; the wide-dynamic-range channels TRACE the line internally (HI 0.92+-0.15, SPARC 1.03+-0.09, clusters 0.85+-0.13), while the narrow dispersion windows CROSS it (bright dSph sigma plateau, Nu = 0.46; GC virial locus, Nu = 2.36) at zero points +0.05/+0.06 -- with THREE quantified exceptions: (1) the UFD dispersion departure, +0.40 dex median over 20 objects (obs sigma ~2.5x pred; residual slope +0.16 +- 0.02 per dex -- the low-end split); (2) the cluster normalization gap, T_obs/T_pred = 3.57x (+0.55 dex in T, +0.27 dex in sigma_dyn,3D), tight at 0.05-dex scatter -- parallel, offset; the registered free-dust normalization stays an input; (3) the GC crossing at M_cross = 1.23e5 M_sun, r_M/r_h = 3.39 = eta/2. THE NUMBER: pooled rms 0.221 dex over N = 248 objects (rms about the identity line); the TRIO that both traces and calibrates the line (bright dSph + HI + SPARC) holds it to 0.135 dex -- the 10-decade line is ONE slope-1 line at ~0.15-dex precision, with two known amplitude departures at its ends (UFD, clusters), not a slope artifact and not a set of per-mass calibrations.
